name: outer_changes
expr: (lambda en: [(r.RedlineType, r.RedlineAuthor, r.RedlineDateTime.Year, r.RedlineDateTime.Month, r.RedlineDateTime.Day, r.RedlineDateTime.Hours, r.RedlineDateTime.Minutes, r.RedlineComment) for r in en(doc.Redlines.createEnumeration()) if r.RedlineAuthor != 'Unknown Author'])(lambda e:[e.nextElement() for _ in iter(e.hasMoreElements, False)])
